settings.heading: Built on Calgary roads, powered by honest service
settings.body:
TL;DR: Family-owned tire and wheel shop at 111 42 Ave SW in Calgary. 26 brands stocked. 3,923 active SKUs. ~15,000 vehicles serviced. 4.9★ from 562+ Google reviews. Same-day installation on most stocked sizes, price-matched against any local Calgary competitor.

Prince Tires started with one simple idea: Calgary drivers deserve a tire shop they can actually trust. No hidden fees, no upsells, no runaround — just straight-up expertise and fair prices on every set of tires we touch.

We've built our reputation one vehicle at a time, helping families across NE Calgary, NW Calgary, and every corner of the city stay safe through Alberta's brutal winters and everything in between. From the October 1 winter-tire deadline to spring changeover, we're the shop Calgarians call first.

Today we stock 26 tire and wheel brands — including Consumer Reports Best-rated Michelin, Bridgestone, Continental, BFGoodrich, Toyo, Yokohama, Cooper, and value picks like Radar and Tesche. Every winter and all-weather tire we sell carries the 3PMSF (three-peak mountain snowflake) certification required by the Alberta winter-tire law and the BC Highway 1, 93, and 99 winter-tire mandate from October 1 through April 30.

Run by a Calgary family. The Prince Tires team services around 70 vehicles a week from the 111 42 Ave SW shop. Most stocked sizes installed in ~45 minutes; trucks and duallies need a 60-minute slot. We process Michelin, Bridgestone, BFGoodrich, and other manufacturer warranties directly on behalf of customers.

settings.question: What tire brands does Prince Tires carry?
settings.answer: We stock 26 tire and wheel brands at our 111 42 Ave SW Calgary location — Michelin, Bridgestone, Continental, BFGoodrich, Toyo, Yokohama, Mickey Thompson, Cooper, Firestone, Kumho, General Tire, Falken, Nexen, Dunlop, plus value picks like Radar, Tesche, Haida, and Rotalla. Wheel brands include XF Off-Road, RTX, and ENVY. See the full lineup at /pages/brands.

settings.question: How long does tire installation take?
settings.answer: Most standard tire installations take 45–60 minutes. This includes mounting, balancing, and a safety check. We offer same-day appointments and accept walk-ins based on availability — call ahead to confirm.

settings.question: Do you carry winter tires for Calgary winters?
settings.answer: Yes — winter tires are one of our specialties. We stock a wide selection of winter-rated tires suited to Calgary's climate, including studded and studless options. We recommend switching to winter tires when temperatures consistently drop below 7°C, which in Calgary is typically October through April.

settings.question: What areas do you serve?
settings.answer: We serve all of Calgary — NE, NW, SE, SW, and Downtown — as well as surrounding communities including Airdrie, Cochrane, Okotoks, Chestermere, Crossfield, Strathmore, and High River. Mobile tire service is available in select areas; call to confirm coverage.

settings.question: Do you offer price matching?
settings.answer: Yes. If you find a lower price on the same tire from a local Calgary competitor, bring us the quote and we'll match it. We believe the best price in Calgary should also come with the best service.

settings.question: Is an appointment required?
settings.answer: We recommend booking an appointment to guarantee your time slot, but we do accept walk-ins when space is available. Same-day and next-day appointments are usually available — book online or give us a call.

settings.question: Who runs Prince Tires?
settings.answer: Prince Tires is a family-owned and operated tire and wheel shop based in Calgary's Manchester / Inglewood area at 111 42 Ave SW. The team installs roughly 70 vehicles per week year-round and processes manufacturer warranty claims directly with Michelin, Bridgestone, BFGoodrich, Toyo, and other brand partners on behalf of customers.

settings.question: Are your tires 3PMSF certified for Alberta's winter-tire law?
settings.answer: Yes. Every winter and all-weather tire we sell carries the 3PMSF (three-peak mountain snowflake) symbol required by Alberta's winter-tire framework and the BC mountain mandate on Highway 93, Highway 99, and the Trans-Canada through Banff (Oct 1 – Apr 30). We also stock studded and studable options for icy rural commutes.

settings.question: Do you service trucks, SUVs, and commercial vehicles?
settings.answer: Yes. We service all vehicle types including sedans, crossovers, SUVs, pickup trucks, and light commercial vehicles. Let us know your vehicle year, make, and model when booking so we can confirm we have your size in stock.
